Name: Scroll Through Options In Character Customization Menu
Author: pneuma163
Description:
Move the cursor onto any option in the character customization menu that has a left and right arrow or that has HSV bars to select a color. Scroll your mouse scroll wheel to change that option. This particularly gives you more precision with choosing a color and lets you focus on the way your character looks as you do so.

Works in any CharacterCustomization menu instance whether you are creating a new character, changing your appearance in the Wizard's basement, or dying your clothes.

[size=5]How to install:[/size]

[size=3]- Install the latest version of SMAPI [url=https://smapi.io]https://smapi.io[/url]
- Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]
- Run the game using SMAPI.

If you need additional help installing the mod, the Stardew Valley wiki [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started[/url] has more detailed instructions.
To uninstall the mod, delete this mod's folder from your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.

Note: the mod can be installed (or removed) at any time.[/size]
